text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Integrating MemGPT’s virtual context paging mechanism into lifelong‑memory agents will prevent the sharp QA accuracy drop observed when the stored fact count exceeds ~40 items, by keeping the active token window within budget.","confidence":0.66,"support_ids":["f7b5be16","a962f389","562412ff"],"tags":["memory","paging","accuracy_drop","lifelong_memory"]},{"statement":"The QA accuracy degradation after 40 stored items is primarily due to token‑budget overflow caused by naive append strategies, explaining the reviewer’s observation that append “blows the token budget” and supporting the need for a rewrite‑vs‑append ablation.","confidence":0.71,"support_ids":["ad2ef3b4","562412ff"],"tags":["append","token_budget","accuracy_drop","ablation"]}]}
